description: ChainAdmin.multicall: ServerNotifier.setUpgradeTimestamp(8022833, …) — announces when the chain may take the cut. Requires stage 1 to have registered the v33 upgrade cut, which is why this file must run after the ecosystem scenario.
ChainAdmin.multicall: upgradeChainFromVersion(chain 8022833, 0x1f00000001 -> 0x2100000000) plus its DA setup — THE per-chain diamond cut.
